subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: What user-facing contract should OpenClaw expose when a managed Gateway is partially reloaded after plugin/config maintenance on macOS launchd?
rationale: The code already has several partial mechanisms, but deciding whether `sessions.resolve` should fail retryably, Control UI should block on readiness, restart should wait longer, or recovery should require a new degraded state is product behavior across Gateway, sessions, and UI.

options.title: Define shared degraded-state contract
options.body: Make Gateway readiness/reload state authoritative for session RPCs and Control UI, then validate it with a macOS launchd replay.

options.title: Land only the WebChat notice subset
options.body: Review the open WebChat PR as a narrow no-notice improvement while keeping this broader readiness issue open.

options.title: Treat live maintenance as unsupported
options.body: Close the broader behavior as operator error and document that disruptive plugin/config maintenance requires an offline restart window.

recommendation.title: Define shared degraded-state contract
recommendation.body: Make Gateway readiness/reload state authoritative for session RPCs and Control UI, then validate it with a macOS launchd replay.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signals for sessions.resolve, service-mode stale process cleanup, and central gateway/session files point to steipete/Peter Steinberger.
